info.title: Funnels API
info.description: Generated from server/src/routes/spec.ts by `npm run docs:api`. Errors are `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`; lists are `{ data, pagination }`. See docs/API.md for examples and docs/RATE-LIMITING.md for limits.

get.x-rate-limit-exempt: Orchestrator probe; no data, must answer under any load

get.summary: Readiness: database reachable, buffer depth, migrations applied
Signed resolve call from the Cloudflare worker
get.description: HMAC over timestamp, nonce, method and path; fails closed without EDGE_SHARED_SECRET.

post.summary: Batch of beacon events forwarded by the edge queue consumer (up to 500)
post.description: Signed like /internal/edge/resolve. Body `{events:[{id,at,ua,body}]}`; each `body` is validated as a public event. Replays of the same `id`/`at` are dropped. 503 INGEST_BACKPRESSURE tells the queue to retry later.

get.summary: Signed preview of a funnel (first step)
get.description: Authorised by a short-lived token in ?token=.

get.summary: Signed preview of a funnel step

post.summary: Record a page view or opt-in (accepted into a write-behind buffer)
post.description: Keyed by IP and the funnelId in the body.

post.summary: Create an account and its workspace
Short-lived ticket for the SSE stream

patch.summary: Rename the workspace, toggle custom scripts

post.summary: Add a member with a one-time password
Check a step path for format and collisions

patch.summary: Update a funnel (status, domain, tags, tracking code)

delete.summary: Move a funnel to the trash

get.summary: Funnel analytics for a date range and time zone

put.summary: Save the page document (optimistic concurrency on `version`)

delete.summary: Delete a domain (funnels revert to test)

get.summary: Step paths served on the domain

put.summary: Set the domain home and 404 steps

post.summary: Create a funnel from a template
Publish a funnel as a global template (PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS)

get.summary: Recently limited subjects, block/allow lists and the policy table

post.summary: Block an ip, workspace or user for a TTL

delete.summary: Lift a block (and clear its penalty box)

post.summary: Allow-list a client for a TTL (bypasses its limits)

put.summary: Override a workspace plan or rate multiplier

RateLimited.description: Rate limited (429) or overloaded (503). Always carries Retry-After and RateLimit headers.
